expo.name: ReceiptIQ
expo.description: Demo project — a receipt/listing analyzer that flags overpriced items and hidden subscription/fee traps. Pricing data is illustrative, not live-verified.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ReceiptIQ uses the camera to photograph a receipt so it can be scanned.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ReceiptIQ needs photo access to let you pick a receipt image to scan.
